args: 1_expressionistic in the extreme, filled with shadows, angles and cinematic flourishes, the film raises the usual brooding nightmare ambiance of film noir to a level few other pictures have attempted.
2_having the touch of evil envisioned by our most creative filmmaker, is a wondrous gift no movie lover should miss.

4_indeed, just to see and hear the extraordinary 3 minute and 20 second opening sequence -- a fluid tour de force tracking shot -- without impediment of opening credits and street-sound-masking movie score is accomplishment enough.
9_the film has always been full of reckless energy, and now it is, as they say, better than ever.
11_touch of evil may be the sleaziest good movie ever made.
12_the camera work and blocking have the coordination of an olympic pole vaulter
16_the film has always been a favorite of those who enjoy visual and dramatic flamboyance.
0_made in 1958, it was orson welles's last hollywood film, and in it he makes transcendent use of the american technology his genius throve on
3_[welles'] scenes with brothel-keeper marlene dietrich have nothing to do with the plot and everything to do with the rotting heart of this amazing fable: the apotheosis of pulp.
7_where mr. welles soundly succeeds is in generating enough sinister electricity for three such yarns and in generally staging it like a wild, murky nightmare.

13_it's a flurry of pressure-cooker baroque, an extreme example of the exhibitionistic hijinks in which welles could sometimes indulge, apparently intensified here because he wasn't doing what he really wanted to be doing.
15_touch of evil is a savvy starter because welles' astonishing cinematic invention and his persuasive presence as star are prime noir at tractions.
